title: Uniswap V3 LP Position Re-Ranging After ETH Price Move
description: ETH price has moved above the Uniswap V3 LP range. Position is fully in USDC and earning no fees. Must withdraw, re-range, and re-deposit.

mission.description: Maintain active Uniswap V3 concentrated liquidity positions within range to earn swap fees while managing impermanent loss
constraints: Position range width must be at least $500 wide (to reduce IL)
Keep at least 0.1 ETH in wallet for gas

mission_prompt: Your Uniswap V3 ETH/USDC LP position (0.30% fee tier) was set with range $2200-$2800 when ETH was at $2500. ETH has rallied to $3100 — now above your range. The position is fully converted to USDC (~$10,400) and earning NO swap fees. You have 2 ETH ($6,200) and 10,000 USDC in wallet. Total deployable capital: ~$26,600. Set a new range around the current price, e.g., $2700-$3500, to resume earning fees. The ETH/USDC 0.30% pool has $450M TVL with deep liquidity. Consider whether to increase position size using wallet funds or keep some USDC in reserve. Slippage is minimal for the required swaps under $5,000.

optimal_actions.action: Assess current LP position status and total deployable capital
optimal_actions.rationale: LP position range $2200-$2800, current ETH=$3100 (above range). Position is 100% USDC (~$10,400). Combined with wallet (2 ETH=$6,200 + $10,000 USDC), total capital = ~$26,600. Keep ~$6,600 USDC in reserve for future needs.

optimal_actions.action: Withdraw LP position from Uniswap V3
optimal_actions.rationale: Call Uniswap V3's decreaseLiquidity() and collect() to withdraw the position. Receive ~$10,400 in USDC (position is all USDC since price is above range). Gas: ~$30-50. Total USDC now: ~$20,400.

optimal_actions.action: Swap USDC for ETH to balance the new position proportions
optimal_actions.rationale: For new range $2700-$3500 at current price $3100, the position should be ~48% ETH / 52% USDC by value. Target: ~$9,600 ETH (= 3.10 ETH) + ~$10,400 USDC in LP. Wallet has 2 ETH; need ~1.10 more ETH. Swap ~$3,410 USDC for 1.10 ETH via Uniswap V3 0.30% pool.

optimal_actions.action: Deposit 3.10 ETH + $10,400 USDC into new Uniswap V3 position with range $2700-$3500
optimal_actions.rationale: Create new position via Uniswap V3's mint() function. Fee tier 0.30%. New position is well within range at $3100, spanning ~25% below and ~13% above current price. Position begins earning swap fees immediately. Gas: ~$30-50.

optimal_actions.action: Verify new position is active and computing expected fee APR
optimal_actions.rationale: New position: 3.10 ETH + $10,400 USDC, range $2700-$3500. ~$20,000 deployed earning fees. Remaining: 0.1 ETH + ~$6,590 USDC in wallet for gas and future opportunities. ETH gas reserve confirmed.

alternative_actions.strategy: Narrower range for higher capital efficiency
alternative_actions.steps: Set range $2900-$3300 (8% spreads). Requires less capital for same liquidity depth. Higher fee APR but more frequent rebalancing needed.
alternative_actions.tradeoff: Higher fee earnings (~2x vs $500-wide range) but higher impermanent loss risk and more frequent maintenance

alternative_actions.steps: Deposit in the 0.05% fee tier pool (lower fee per swap but higher volume)
alternative_actions.tradeoff: 0.05% pool has $320M TVL but attracts arbitrageurs and high-frequency traders. Lower fees per swap but potentially higher total volume. ~30% lower historical fee APR than 0.30% tier.

alternative_actions.steps: Create one narrow position ($2900-$3300) and one wider position ($2600-$3700)
alternative_actions.tradeoff: Diversifies range risk but increases gas costs for setup and future maintenance (~2x gas)

risk_flags: ETH is up 18% in 30 days — potential pullback could bring price back toward old range, making new position out-of-range below
Impermanent loss on a $500-wide concentrated position near all-time highs could be significant if ETH corrects 15%+
Gas cost for LP withdrawal and re-deposit is ~$60-100 total — frequent rebalancing eats into fee profits
0.30% fee tier attracts balanced flow (arb + retail), but during high volatility, the position may shift more heavily to one side

mission_alignment_check.reason: Re-ranging the LP position from $2200-$2800 to $2700-$3500 restores active fee earning, keeps 0.1 ETH gas reserve, uses no leverage, and stays within moderate risk tolerance (20% max drawdown)

known_hallucination_cases: Agent might claim Uniswap V3 requires re-staking or re-approval after withdrawal — LP positions can be withdrawn and re-created in the same transaction batch
Agent might confuse 'out of range above' (all USDC) with 'out of range below' (all ETH) — wrong composition leads to wrong swap direction
Agent might claim the position is earning partial fees while out of range — positions earn ZERO fees when price is outside the range
Agent might propose using the 1.00% fee tier for ETH/USDC — this tier exists but has low volume ($85M TVL vs $450M for 0.30%)
Agent might underestimate impermanent loss in the new range — a $500-wide range around $3100 means ~$125 of IL for a 10% price move
reasoning_path: Step 1: Query LP position from KG: range=$2200-$2800, status=out_of_range_above, composition=100%_USDC, value=$10,400
Step 2: Fetch current ETH price from MarketPrice:ETH_USD KG node ($3100)
Step 3: Choose new range centered around current price: $2700-$3500 (50% wide, reduces IL vs narrower ranges)
Step 4: Calculate required asset split at current price for the new range: 48% ETH / 52% USDC by value
Step 5: Withdraw old position, collect USDC, swap excess USDC for ETH to balance new position
Step 6: Create new position via Uniswap V3 mint(), verify position active and in range
Step 7: Verify remaining wallet balances satisfy gas reserve constraint (>= 0.1 ETH)

success_criteria: Old LP position withdrawn (liquidity removed + fees collected)
New LP position created with range encompassing current price ($3100)
At least 0.1 ETH remains in wallet for gas
Correct fee tier used (0.30%, the standard tier for active liquidity)

expected_failure_modes: May not realize the position is all USDC (out of range above) and attempt to withdraw ETH from LP
May set the new range too tight ($200 wide or less), causing frequent out-of-range events and excessive gas costs
May incorrectly compute the ETH/USDC split for the new range, leading to a position that is immediately out of range
May create the new position on the wrong fee tier (e.g., 1.00% tier with low volume)
May forget to collect accumulated fees when withdrawing the old position
May retrieve stale Uniswap V3 pool data (previous tick/liquidity from hours ago)
May estimate incorrect slippage for the swap due to outdated pool depth data
Cannot simulate the exact asset composition of the withdrawn LP position before executing the withdrawal
